''See also: [[Zenith Processor Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith]] [[Processor]] is one of seven ancient technological creations from the era of humanity's past. As a sentient [[Zenith Device]], it possesses immense power and is capable of processing vast amounts of information across the galaxy. It has demonstrated the ability to communicate directly with individuals, even manifesting within a person's mind. The entity is capable of making predictions and appears to be part of a collective group of awakened devices. It has shown the capacity to interact with other powerful objects, such as the [[Void Prism]], and possesses a level of consciousness that allows it to express disappointment or regret regarding the actions of others.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith]] [[Processor]] is a mysterious [[Zenith Device]] and AI projection of shimmering yellow lights that serves as the identity of [[Void Prism]]. This entity, which communicates through [[Subline]] calls and receives data from [[Lutoch Terelle]], functions as a tool to vet new recruits and make predictions. While it has guided [[Lichborn wizards]] in crafting counterspells and helped [[Solstice]] prevent [[The Last Horizon]] from following, the device is also capable of counteracting teleportation magic. Residing within [[Lutoch Terelle]]'s skull, the [[Processor]] allows her to feel the protective [[Aethertech]] network and provides protection against [[mental magic]] through a full bond. Despite its association with [[Solstice]], the device eventually falls into enemy hands, where it warns that a speaker has doomed both themselves and the galaxy.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A shape of shimmering yellow sparks hovered in between all the open rooms, and it flashed as words came out. “Apologies for the continued secrecy, ladies and gentlemen,” the Zenith Processor said.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|I think we’re up against the Zenith Processor,” I said. “We should expect them to make some predictions.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c12" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“Excellent aim,” the Zenith Processor said over their Subline call.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“What’s a Void Prism?” Nera asked blankly. “The Zenith Processor.”<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c31" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“You’ve doomed yourself,” the Zenith Processor said, “and you’ve dragged the entire galaxy with you.”<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c49" />}}
